info.about: Silent Hill: Origins is a 2007 survival horror game developed by Climax Studios and published by Konami. It was released worldwide in late 2007 for the PlayStation Portable, beginning in early November with the United Kingdom.
info.trivia: Development moved from Climax's Los Angeles studio to its British team in Portsmouth, which redid the script, monsters and level design.
info.why: The PS2 version was a port released four months after the PSP original and more than a year after the PS3 launched, so it reached a shrinking PS2 audience.
